summary: Connect sum and carry outputs to all three input bits.
objective: Show a full adder with A, B and carry-in controls, tracing the sum and carry paths.
example_prompts: Show a full adder with A, B and carry-in controls, tracing the sum and carry paths.

entities.name: Adder stages
entities.guidance: Model two XOR blocks, carry-generate/propagate blocks and output terminals; show the actual graph, not ornamental wires.

entities.name: Bit outputs
entities.guidance: Place S and carry-out together with binary weights 1 and 2; separate material emphasis from value labels.

state_contract.model: A,B,Cin are bits; S=A XOR B XOR Cin; Cout=(A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B)).
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Compare weighted output with input sum.

invariants: A+B+Cin = S+2*Cout for all eight combinations.
Carry-in cannot be omitted or treated as a clock.
One input change updates both outputs atomically.
motion_guidance: Highlight generate and propagate terms after calculation.
Any delayed trail is educational sequencing, not measured gate delay.
known_limits: Single stage only; no ripple timing or transistor-level behavior.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: The full-adder sum is (A XOR B) XOR carry-in; carry can be generated by the operand bits or propagated from carry-in.

object_craft.structure: Model two XOR blocks, carry-generate/propagate blocks and output terminals; show the actual graph, not ornamental wires.
object_craft.material: Uniform neutral gate blocks; restrained distinct accents for sum and carry paths and explicit 1/2 weight labels.
